title: Every share card wears the dark Stage theme, with the entity's own image

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const cp=require('child_process');const files=cp.execSync('git ls-files app lib/og').toString().split('\n').filter(f=>/(opengraph-image\.tsx|og-root-card\/route\.tsx|claim-card\.tsx|event-card\.tsx)$/.test(f));const bad=[];for(const f of files){const s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(/from ['\"]@\/lib\/og\/load-nunito['\"]/.test(s)||/rgba\(13,\s*13,\s*18/.test(s))bad.push(f+' still draws its own Nunito or near-black card')}for(const f of ['lib/og/stage-card.tsx','lib/og/load-stage-fonts.ts','public/fonts/stage/Unbounded-Bold.ttf','public/fonts/stage/InstrumentSerif-Italic.ttf','public/fonts/stage/HankenGrotesk-Bold.ttf'])if(!fs.existsSync(f))bad.push(f+' is missing');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1269: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"

detail: Owner request 2026-10-21: all share cards (the Open Graph and Twitter link previews) redesigned in the dark Frequency theme with images, following the design system. Before: fifteen hand-copied layouts in Nunito on near-black, five of them with no image at all. After: one layout, lib/og/stage-card.tsx, in the Stage theme of design_handoff/frequency (canvas #0A0612, pastel and iridescent accents, aura fallback) set in Unbounded for the title, Instrument Serif italic for the one human line and Hanken Grotesk for the facts, 1200x630 with 64px safe margins, a clamped title, and the entity's own image full-bleed under a Stage scrim (events, Spaces, journeys, practices, claim links, help) or the branded aura card when there is none. Routes keep their own data, privacy gates and hero resolution and only supply strings. The root card file was regenerated. Hosted-site cards (menswork-site-card) stay on the site's own brand on purpose. Alt text and twitter:card summary_large_image are unchanged: Next emits summary_large_image whenever a card image exists. Before and after renders in /mnt/project-files/share-cards/.
